method_note: All data gathered via web search only (WebFetch/direct scholarly-site access blocked by egress policy). Evidence classes used: (1) 'full-text match' = the citing paper's own arxiv.org/aclanthology PDF-or-HTML page was returned by a search whose quoted exact-phrase terms include the target's name or arXiv ID, implying the phrase appears in that paper's text/references; (2) search-result snippet text describing the citation relationship. Where a verbatim citing sentence was surfaced it is copied into context_snippets; AI-paraphrased search summaries are NOT placed in context_snippets. arXiv ID corrections vs. task brief: Hard2Verify is 2510.13744 (not 2510.14744); sports-autoencoder is 2007.10257 (not 2011.10021).
